name: always-on-fire
about: 启用项目、tickIntervalMinutes 调到 0.05（3 秒一跳）后调度器自己触发一轮完整的 always-on：discovery 轮次（无聊天摘要、调用 always_on_discovery_plan 存计划）→ workspace 轮次（auto 选 snapshot-copy 建快照）→ execute 轮次（在工作区里 write_file）→ report 轮次（always_on_report）；第二跳被 cooldown 挡住。比较全部通知、发给 provider 的请求（discovery 提示词、always_on_* 工具声明）、events / runs / run-history / plans / cycles / reports / state 与快照内容。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
alwaysOn:
  trigger:
    tickIntervalMinutes: 0.05
  projects:
    {HOME}/work/alpha:
      enabled: true
